name: BBT token unprotected setRegistry enables unlimited mint
summary: BBT.setRegistry(address) had no access control, so the attacker pointed the token at a registry contract of their own whose getContractAddress() returned the caller, passing the mint() authorization check and minting 1e31 BBT that was dumped on Uniswap V2.
